content:
- Committed the boundary cleanup as 9c3cb50 (Keep CLI decode errors typed) and pushed it to origin/master successfully.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it exited 0, updated .ralph/current_tasks.md and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md, sent the status email, and again printed the known rm warning for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next if a new context window starts: read progress, inspect the freshly switched Ralph task files, and continue from that new task state.

- Read prior progress and loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill.
- Checked git status; only existing Ralph task/progress files were dirty from the prior task switch.
- Checked for found smells. There is no repo-level found_smells/ directory; the skill's own found_smells only contains .gitkeep, so this run needs a fresh smell pick.
- Inspected src/cli/config.rs, src/config/materialize.rs, and tests/ha/support/error.rs as initial boundary candidates.
- Next: inspect a few adjacent modules to choose one concrete boundary issue that reduces code instead of adding new shapes.

- Proved the helper boundary with the skill workflow by renaming resolve_postgres_client_tls and running make check; the compiler reported exactly one call site in resolve_operator_context.
- Reverted the temporary rename by inlining the postgres TLS materialization directly into resolve_operator_context and deleting the now-dead helper.
- Also flattened repeated config_source.as_ref() bouncing in resolve_operator_context by borrowing once and threading the borrowed option through the remaining helper calls.
- Next: run formatting if needed, then make lint and make test, inspect any failures, and only then commit/push/task-switch.

- Ran cargo fmt --all after the boundary edit.
- make lint passed after one small fix to stop passing Option<&&OperatorConfigSource> into resolve_api_resolution.
- make test passed via cargo nextest: 244/244 tests green, 16 skipped, nextest reported 5 leaky tests in the existing suite.
- Next: stage src/cli/config.rs together with the current .ralph updates, create a commit for the boundary cleanup, push it, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh and record the result.
